The '''Brak Sector Force''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Force]] assigned to the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. The force was commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Trep Reskan]], with its headquarters on [[Tel III]], codenamed [[Oracle Base]].
